# AlgoContentSEO

> AlgoContentSEO is an outsourced business manager for owner-led firms, based in Santa Monica, California and working across the United States. The firm handles business management, marketing, PR and social media as a working part of the client team.

## Start here
- [Home](https://www.algocontentseo.com/): Who the firm is, what it does and how an engagement runs.
- [The 90-Day Plan](https://www.algocontentseo.com/90-day-plan.html): A fixed fee of $10,000 ($5,000 to start, $2,500 on day 30, $2,500 on day 60) for a written list of deliverables. A $2,500 real estate pitch deck is available as an add-on for plan clients.
- [The primer](https://www.algocontentseo.com/primer.html): "Who Are You and Why Should We Hire You?" Available to subscribers on request. The text is not published on the site.

## Industries
- [Dental practices](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/dental-practices.html): The dentist belongs in the operatory. We run the business side, from follow-up lists to the website, reviews and social media.
- [Motorcycle businesses](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/motorcycle-businesses.html): Riding season does not wait for your marketing. We keep the shop visible while your crew is busy on the floor and in the bays.
- [Real estate](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/real-estate.html): Investors and partners look you up before the first meeting. We keep the website, the project stories and the deck ready all year.
- [Fashion labels](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/fashion-labels.html): The collection is ready. The line sheet, the press note and the posts are not. We run the business side as part of your studio.
- [Film and music video](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/film-and-music-video.html): A finished film still needs an audience, and a director needs the next job. We run the business side between one project and the next.
- [Interior designers](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/interior-designers.html): Your best rooms are sitting in a folder, unphotographed and unpublished. We run the business side as part of your studio.
- [Independent music](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/music-managers-and-artists.html): A release is forty small jobs with one date. Through DecodedMusic we run the business side as part of the artist's team.
- [Independent financial managers](https://www.algocontentseo.com/industries/independent-financial-managers.html): Clients want a clear explanation and compliance wants every word checked. We manage the business side inside your review process.

## Insights
- [What an outsourced business manager does, and how to tell if you need one](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/what-an-outsourced-business-manager-does.html): Not a bookkeeper, not an agency, not an assistant. A plain account of the job, a typical week and how to tell if your firm needs one.
- [Business manager or marketing agency: who should run your marketing?](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/business-manager-or-marketing-agency.html): Agency, freelancer, in-house hire or outsourced business manager. An honest comparison, including the cases where the answer is not us.
- [PR, marketing and social media are three different jobs. Here is who does what.](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/pr-marketing-social-media-who-does-what.html): Three jobs owners are told to do and rarely have explained. What each does for a small firm, and the order to do them in.
- [The ten minutes before they call: what a prospect checks, and what they find](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/what-prospects-check-before-they-call.html): Someone hears your name and looks you up. Here is what they check, in order, and a twenty-minute way to audit your own firm.
- [A weekly marketing routine a busy owner can keep](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/weekly-marketing-routine.html): Marketing fails in small firms because nobody owns it and nothing is due. A one-hour weekly routine and the rules that keep it alive.
- [How to make an outside manager part of your team](https://www.algocontentseo.com/insights/outside-manager-part-of-your-team.html): Outside help fails when it stays outside. One approver, a weekly rhythm, clear ownership and a clean way to stop.

## Commitments
Client-owned websites, accounts, content and contact lists. Honest claims. Coordination with counsel and compliance staff in regulated fields. No promises of rankings, press coverage or a number of new clients.
